name: Peru–Bolivian Confederation (1836–1839)
description: A red field charged with the confederation's arms — the emblems of Bolivia and the two Perus wreathed in laurel, borne by condors.
history: Flag of Marshal Santa Cruz's Peru–Bolivian Confederation, broken up by Chile at the battle of Yungay in 1839.

features.role: joint arms of North Peru, South Peru and Bolivia
